subject: Demo: Redwood + GitHub integration
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@openlib.dev>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — Redwood + GitHub integration

Hi Camila,

We recently came across Redwood while evaluating inference runtimes for some of our open-source projects on GitHub (https://github.com/openlib). A few engineers on my team are interested in how Redwood handles GitHub-based workflows — specifically: private repo access for inference with actions, how KV/prefix caching behaves with repo-based prompts, and whether you have out-of-the-box integrations with GitHub Actions or webhooks.

We signed up for the self-serve trial but would love a short demo (30 minutes) to walk through integration patterns and deployment options. Could we schedule something this week? We'd like to include one of our platform engineers (I'll loop them in).

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Senior Engineer, OpenLib
samir@openlib.dev

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@openlib.dev>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood + GitHub integration

Hi Samir — great to meet you and thanks for trying Redwood. I'm Camila (SDR on the GTM team). Happy to set up a 30-min demo so we can show how teams integrate Redwood with GitHub workflows and answer the engineering questions. I've looped Alex (solutions engineer) into the thread — he'll cover the technical patterns (Actions, private repo auth, prefix caching).

A few options this week (PT):
- Wed 8/18 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu 8/19 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Fri 8/20 9:00–9:30am PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows and we can reschedule. Also, could you paste a short note on your primary use-case (batch inference from Actions vs ad-hoc inference from PRs vs CI gating)? That will help Alex tailor the demo.

Attaching a short one-pager with integration highlights. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

From: Samir Shah <samir@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenLib Engineering <devs@openlib.dev>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood + GitHub integration

Camila — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Alex in.

Wed 8/18 10:00am PT works well for us.

Quick context on the use-case: we run a suite of model-driven checks and a few comment-bot features triggered by GitHub Actions. Key questions for the demo:
- Can Redwood run inference inside Actions against private repos without exposing repo contents to hosted/shared runtimes?
- How does prefix/KV caching work when requests are generated from PR diffs (variable-length prompts)?
- Any examples of connecting Secrets/credentials (we use GitHub Secrets and AWS KMS) for private model access?

Also: do you offer short-term trial credits for evaluation on dedicated capacity? If so, what is the process to request them?

Appreciate it — Samir
